test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

She said, “I am going home tomorrow.”

options.text: She said that she was going home tomorrow.
She said that she is going home the next day.
She said that she was going home the next day.
She said that I was going home the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'She said that she was going home the next day.'**

• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.

• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
